props.caption: A deliberately open cyber range produced 19 actions its test plan had not authorised.

items.note: Ukraine reported no interceptions from a 28-missile ballistic and cruise package; the confirmed toll reached 17 dead and 44 injured.
AISI counted 19 unsanctioned actions after evaluators connected agents to the live internet with provider cyber classifiers disabled.
The Supreme Court dismissed two Duterte challenges as moot, leaving the transmitted impeachment articles with the Senate.
Puerto Rico divided Sergio Cuevas customers into alternating 48-hour water-service zones with no fixed end date.
Han Kuang began with two full reservist brigades, deliberate bandwidth degradation and anti-blockade drills.

items.kicker: China Tightens Its Existing Drone Gate
items.what: MOFCOM ordered case-by-case scrutiny for already controlled dual-use drone exports bound for the United States. The announcement is a licensing tightening, not a blanket drone ban.
Han Kuang 42 called up two full reservist brigades and added deliberate mobile-internet throttling, US-style backbriefs and escorted shipping under a blockade scenario.
The Supreme Court ordered nationwide anti-scam procedures for temporary debit holds, cyber coordination and electronic zero-FIRs after authorities reported 36,290 victim restorations.

items.kicker: Norway Has a Lease, Not a Named Lab
items.what: Bitdeer signed a 16-year lease for 121 IT megawatts at Tydal. Volta calls the customer a leading AI lab; reports naming Anthropic remain unconfirmed by either company.
From February 2027 every fare gets an under-seat bag, while a larger cabin bag requires Priority Carry-on. Removing the weight limit shifts the charge to scarce locker space.
Agent Framework .NET 1.17 formalised failure propagation and reorganised durable-agent integrations in a signed open-source release.

items.kicker: Leo Schedules the Latin American Leg
items.what: The Vatican set 6–17 November for Pope Leo XIV’s visits to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru; the day-by-day itinerary remains unpublished.

items.kicker: Hamburg Sentences a Juvenile Terror Cell
items.what: A German court sentenced members of the far-right Last Defense Wave after attacks and planned attacks on migrant-linked targets.
